titulo: Great Britain’s oldest renewables projects could rake in nearly £9bn next year
cuerpo: Subsidy scheme, which is paid via taxes and energy bills, must be reformed, ECU analysis finds Business live – latest updates Great Britain’s oldest renewable energy projects are likely to rake in a near £9bn windfall next year because of soaring market prices, according to independent analysis. The research has revealed that almost a third of the UK’s wind and solar farms that rely on the government’s legacy renewables subsidy scheme are in line for soaring subsidy payments as officials grapple with plans to lower the country’s energy costs.
